## Standing operator rules
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always use db-stg-2 for staging.
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, where customers receive 400s. Pagination was superseded; the annotation work is continuing.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Per-invoice embedding calls: excessive client overhead.
- Retrying webhook handlers: resent customer emails.
- Applying credit before refund: likely causes incorrect invoice totals.

## Plan and progress
- DONE: billing annotations, tests, mypy, full suite.
- PENDING: inspect and fix Stripe signature verification, then test.
- PENDING: complete order-rules package migration.
- Next: inspect `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` and its tests.
- Status unknown: invoice credit test currently fails (`90.00` vs `87.50`).

## Recent work
Added a reusable `make_invoice` test helper. Full tests previously passed; focused invoice credit coverage exposed an ordering bug.
